intended_behavior: After retrieving and assigning a historical plan to self.current_plan, this async method should call await self._trigger_plan_change_hooks() to trigger all registered plan change hooks, ensuring that observers and UI components are notified of the plan change. This preserves existing functionality but fixes the issue of stale hooks after recovery.

This async method iterates over all registered plan change hooks and safely executes them, handling both synchronous and asynchronous hooks. It is responsible for notifying all subscribers whenever the plan changes. The recovery method and other plan-modifying methods should invoke this method to ensure proper hook triggering.
